turnaround_reason: Charter fell from $286 to ~$152 as broadband subscriber losses accelerated under fixed-wireless (T-Mobile/Verizon) and fiber competition, with management admitting Q1 retention offers were 'too aggressive.' The bull case is a hugely cash-generative, deeply de-rated cable asset (forward P/E ~3.4) where mobile growth and buybacks offset broadband erosion.
bullish_points: Extremely cheap: forward P/E ~3.4, EV/EBITDA ~5.4, FCF ~$2.2B; buybacks resume in Q4 (repurchased $838M in Q2 at ~$210)
Heavy insider buying: net +1.58M shares over 6m including CEO Winfrey (~$1.2M) and multiple directors
Q2 EPS beat ($10.66 vs $10.06); mobile added 400k+ lines (+16% TTM); video losses narrowing
Broadband ARPU expected to improve sequentially in Q3 as aggressive retention offers normalize
Sets 3.5x leverage target; convergence (mobile + broadband bundle) is a structural cost advantage
bearish_points: Core broadband is in secular decline: -172k internet subs in Q2, worse than prior year, driven by fixed-wireless/fiber
Enormous leverage: $96.7B debt, D/E ~441, current ratio 0.36 — equity is a thin sliver of EV, so estimate errors are amplified
Revenue -1.7% YoY and EBITDA -3.2%; weaker profit outlook already flagged
Very high short interest (~50% of float) reflects a strong value-trap thesis
Basing well below trend (-21% vs 200d MA); classic cheap-for-a-reason setup
catalyst: Sequential broadband ARPU recovery and a return to buybacks in Q4 stabilizing per-share metrics even with sub losses
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings Oct 30, 2026; buyback resumption Q4 2026
suggested_trade: Small starter / watchlist only. Wait for broadband sub-loss trajectory to stabilize before sizing up; the leverage makes this a higher-variance value play.
key_risk: Fixed-wireless and fiber keep taking broadband share faster than mobile and ARPU can offset, so EBITDA keeps shrinking against a $97B debt load and equity de-rates further.
would_skip_if: Q3 broadband net losses widen again or management guides EBITDA lower; that confirms the value trap.
